Jharkhand Foundation Day: padmashri Balbir Dutt se sunie alag rajy banne ke kaee kisse | Ranchi
Jharkhand sthapna divas ke khas mauke par padmashri Balbir Dutt se janie alag rajy banne ki kahani. jharkhand aandolan se lekar alag rajy ke gathan tak ke kaee aise kisse, aitihasik ghatnaen aur yaden, jinhen unhonne karib se dekha aur mahsus kiya.
